## Validation and assumptions

The search retrieved all 7 screened relevant development records (100% relative recall on that set). This is not independent validation or an estimate of absolute sensitivity. No seeds were provided, and no prior-review benchmark set was available.

The therapy block would reduce results by 77.4%, but was left out: only 7 known relevant records were available, below the skill’s 15-record threshold for safely requiring an optional block. None of the 30 randomly sampled records it would remove was eligible. The full strategy therefore keeps the Wilson disease block broad.

I assumed “common therapies” means pharmacologic treatments, including chelators and zinc; comparative outcomes and comparators are for screening. Comparative effectiveness of liver transplantation is outside this assumed scope and should be checked against the review protocol. The strategy has no publication-date, language, age, or study-design limits.
